Visual Intelligence engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Apple's Visual Intelligence rollout covers storefront language. Xcode, system frameworks, and Connect actually separate on-device scene understanding from product-page copy:

  • Visual Intelligence APIs & system visual search — platform hooks that let buyers point the camera at objects, scenes, or products and receive on-device understanding or search results. Controls in-app visual-understanding behavior — not App Store language.
  • Vision framework & Core ML — object detection, scene classification, and on-device inference pipelines some apps use for custom visual search. Your listing may mention identify what you see; building Vision models is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Camera Control visual intelligence entry point — on iPhone 16 family devices, Visual Intelligence may launch from the Camera Control button when buyers point at a scene. Marketing may reference Camera Control visual intelligence on screenshots; wiring Capture Control handlers is hardware engineering — see our Camera Control guide for button-gesture listing scope, not scene-understanding copy.
  • Point-and-ask & visual Q&A flows — in-app UX where buyers frame an object and ask a question about what the camera sees. Listing copy explains those buyer benefits; building those integrations is platform and app engineering.
  • Product lookup & visual search backends — commerce or reference APIs that return prices, species names, or metadata from a camera frame. Listing copy may mention shop what you see; server-side search engineering is outside AppLocale scope.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Visual Intelligence support in the binary.

A working Visual Intelligence or visual-search story and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

Visual Intelligence phrasing

US pages use "Visual Intelligence", "Camera Control visual intelligence", "Point the camera and ask", "Understand what you see", or "On-device scene understanding." AppLocale aligns phrasing with Apple's consumer-facing terms while keeping your app's voice — not inventing Visual Intelligence capabilities your app does not support.

Point-and-ask vs visual search vs product lookup

Screenshot overlays differ by use case — ask a question about a framed object, search visually for similar items, or look up product prices from the camera. Chinese buyers expect concise action labels: 看图提问 for point-and-ask, 视觉搜索 for visual search, 拍照识物 for identify-from-camera. Mixing English "Point the camera and ask" with Chinese body copy on the same frame looks inconsistent.

Camera Control visual intelligence vs Camera Control hardware

Apple markets Visual Intelligence alongside Camera Control on iPhone 16 — press the button, point at a scene, get understanding. zh-Hans listing copy should distinguish 视觉智能 scene-understanding value from 相机控制 hardware gesture marketing covered on the Camera Control guide. If your screenshots show both, scope each frame accurately — object-identification overlay on one frame, light-press focus demo on another.

Do not conflate with Live Text OCR

Visual Intelligence understands scenes and objects; Live Text extracts printed text from photos. Listing copy for point-and-ask should not reuse 实况文本 or copy text from photos paragraphs meant for OCR. If your app does both, scope each screenshot frame accurately — text extraction on one frame, visual Q&A on another. See Live Text listing (zh-Hans).

Do not conflate with Image Playground generative images

Visual Intelligence analyzes what the camera sees; Image Playground creates new illustrations from prompts. zh-Hans overlays for scene understanding should not reuse 图像游乐场 or 生成图像 vocabulary from the Image Playground guide unless your screenshots actually show generative illustration flows.
